title: AgentSTAR: Agentic Shape Tracking and Reconstruction from Monocular Videos
abstract: arXiv:2609.24487v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this work, we present a method for shape reconstruction and tracking from video via agentic analysis-by-synthesis. Unlike prior methods which first estimate dense pixel correspondences and then recover object motion from them, our method infers a structured 3D object model, including its geometry and kinematic structure, and uses this model to optimise object track estimates over time. In our optimisation loop, a Vision-Language Model (VLM) agent iteratively refines shape or generalised pose through a render-and-compare loop, combining coarse visual reasoning with numerical pose optimisation for precise state estimation. This structured formulation enables our method to track through large motion, articulation, and severe occlusion without relying on pixel-matching objectives. translated_title: AgentSTAR：基于智能体的单目视频形状跟踪与重建
translated_abstract: 在这项工作中，我们提出了一种通过智能体式“分析-合成”（analysis-by-synthesis）从视频中进行形状重建与跟踪的方法。与先前先估计密集像素对应关系、再据此恢复物体运动的方法不同，我们的方法推断出一个结构化的三维物体模型（包括其几何形状与运动学结构），并利用该模型随时间优化物体跟踪估计。在我们的优化循环中，一个视觉语言模型（VLM）智能体通过“渲染-比较”循环迭代地细化形状或广义姿态，将粗粒度的视觉推理与数值姿态优化相结合，以实现精确的状态估计。这种结构化的表述使我们的方法能够在大运动、关节活动与严重遮挡的情况下进行跟踪，而无需依赖像素匹配目标。在定量评估方面，在ARCTIC数据集上，我们的方法大幅超越了面向铰接物体的最先进三维点跟踪基线；在HOT3D数据集上，它超越了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出AgentSTAR，通过VLM智能体驱动的“分析-合成”优化循环，从单目视频中推断结构化3D物体模型并迭代优化形状与广义姿态，实现了无需像素匹配的大运动、关节活动及严重遮挡下的鲁棒跟踪与重建。
en_tdlr: AgentSTAR presents an agentic analysis-by-synthesis framework that infers a structured 3D object model and iteratively refines shape and generalized pose via a VLM-driven render-and-compare loop, enabling robust tracking and reconstruction from monocular videos under large motion, articulation, and severe occlusion without relying on pixel-matching objectives.
